summary: Recursion Pharmaceuticals filed a preliminary prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $200 million underwritten offering of Class A Common Stock. The last reported Nasdaq sale price was $3.74 per share on October 14, 2026. Underwriters include Leerink Partners, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Evercore ISI and Needham. Pricing, share count, discounts and proceeds are left blank as the document is subject to completion. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch for final pricing, discount to last sale and dilution terms.
